name: Linksy Search and Replace
author: Plugli

sections.description:
Managing internal links and anchors shouldn’t cause a headache. Linksy Search and Replace is designed to eliminate the need to dig through your database, making it the most efficient and user-friendly search and replace tool available. This powerful plugin simplifies internal link editing, anchor text adjustments, and title refinements, all directly from your WordPress dashboard. If you’ve ever used any Search and Replace plugin, Linksy’s is better!

Why Choose Linksy Search and Replace?

  • No Database Headaches: Modify links, anchors, and titles without manually accessing your database.
  • Predefined Search Types: Easily find exact links, anchors, and titles with a variety of search and filtering options.
  • Bulk Actions: Perform quick edits, replacements, removals, and optimizations in one go.
  • Broken Link Fixing: Identify and fix broken internal links effortlessly.
  • Works with Your Popular Page Builders: Unlike others, the plugin reads content from popular page builders and can modify them without any issues.
  • Retain the Best Links: Automatically keep the highest-rated links and remove lower-quality ones (this needs Linksy plugin).

Key Features

Search and Replace Links
* Replace or modify full URLs and specific matched text.
* Unlink or remove links while keeping anchor text.
* Identify two-way and self-referential links.

Search and Replace Anchors
* Modify, replace, or clean up anchor text.
* Fix common formatting issues like extra spaces and punctuation.
* Unlink anchors without affecting surrounding content.

Search and Replace Post Titles
* Find and modify post titles efficiently.
* Remove or replace specific words in bulk.

Search and Replace Broken Links
* Detect and fix broken internal links.
* Redirect, replace, or remove broken URLs with a single click.

Search and Replace Database Tables
* Manage and edit database content without logging into phpMyAdmin.
* Offers precise filtering, editing, and bulk actions across your database tables and columns.

See All Features Here

With Linksy Search and Replace, internal link management has never been easier. Install now and take control of your website’s internal linking strategy today!

Built by the team behind Linksy AI

Who is This Plugin For?

  • Website owners who want a hassle-free way to manage internal links.

  • SEOs looking to optimize internal linking for better rankings.

  • Content managers who need a fast and easy way to fix anchors and titles.
sections.installation:
Install Linksy Search and Replace like you would install any other WordPress plugin.

Dashboard Method:

  1. Login to your WordPress admin and go to Plugins -> Add New.
  2. Type “Linksy Search and Replace” in the search bar and select this plugin.
  3. Click “Install”, and then “Activate Plugin”.
  4. Locate the plugin under Tools and enjoy.
sections.faq:
How to Access Linksy Search and Replace

Linksy Search and Replace will add a page under the “Tools” menu page in your WordPress admin when you activate it.

How many page builders does it support?

We have added full support for Classic editor, Gutenberg editor, Gutenberg-based page builders (Kadence Blocks, Genesis Blocks, Spectra, Essential Blocks, Ultimate Blocks, and Greenshift), Breakdance, Elementor, WPBakery, Thrive, Divi, Avia, Oxygen, Bricks, Avada, Themify, Cornerstone, Betheme(Muffin) and Beaver.

You don’t know what table? Don’t worry, we do!

Is there an action limit?

No limit on the how many search and replace actions you can perform.

Can you undo?

You can’t undo at this time. We ensure a dry run so you can see what you are removing before you make the changes.
sections.changelog:
1.0.4

  • Added post type and post status columns to the Url Replace tab and post type column to the Title Replace Tab
  • Database Replace tab – Added a count display text on columns with more results for quicker navigation of high-frequency matches

1.0.3

  • New – Added a new URL Search and Replace feature. It’s available on its own tab. The present Link tab focuses on replacing links inside content, while the new URL tab lets you find and update post URLs in bulk or individually.
  • New – Added Status/Http code filter to the Broken Links Tab
  • Key background cron jobs that automate link analysis has been refined to optimise efficiency, reduce redundant processing.
  • Updated the “Ignored” tab under Broken Links to display accurate data, consistent with the other tabs.
  • Bug fixes!

1.0.2

  • Broken Links analysis optimization
  • Bug fixes!

1.0.1

  • Bug fixes!

1.0.0

  • Initial release!
